canon: Criatura flaca de cuatro patas, pelaje rojizo rasposo, mechones de pelo negro en los tobillos y patas desproporcionadamente largas; pelaje enredado con parches de arena fosilizada que brillan como vetas minerales rojas, hilera de púas oscuras erizadas en el lomo, colmillos curvos amarillentos exagerados, costillas marcadas, cola negra tupida que borra sus huellas.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:1479 (bio); backend/src/services/sexDimorphism.ts:99-111 (dimorfismo); detalle campo a campo en docs/producto/plan-imagenes/borradores/fichas-piloto.json

prompt.sujeto: A long, low pack hunter with a deep chest and a flexible spine, carried close to the ground on short, strong legs that end in dark curved claws.
prompt.proporcion: Its body is a ribbon: the torso is as long as five of its own heads laid end to end, and the legs are shorter than the chest is deep.
prompt.ancla: the narrow head of a red fox on the long, supple torso of a weasel
prompt.cuerpo: Its head is narrow, with tall pointed ears, an amber eye and two long pale sabre fangs hanging below the lower jaw. The short, dense coat is warm rust brown, paler in faint stripes along the flanks.
rasgos: A crest of overlapping black armoured plates runs unbroken from the nape along the whole spine and down the long banded tail to its dark spiny tip, edged with a row of sharp glowing red spikes.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Tufts of black hair cling to its ankles, and its ribs show faintly under the short coat.
prompt.pose: Seen from a low camera angle in full side profile, it stalks forward with its weight on one foreleg and its head turned slightly toward the viewer.
prompt.manada: Behind it lopes a pack of six hunters, each one a long, low hunter with a rust coat, a black plate crest with red spikes and pale sabre fangs, smaller and hazier with distance.
prompt.entorno: The ground is cracked red earth with sparse dry tufts, and dark dust devils rise far off on the plain.
prompt.luz: The low sun sits behind the pack and rims every coat and spike with fiery orange light, while thick drifting dust glows in the backlight and a dense red-orange haze tints earth and sky alike.

rasgos+: This male is heavier in the neck and shoulders, with longer fangs and a taller crest of spikes.
This female is visibly smaller and slighter, with a narrower head and a lower crest of spikes.

estacion:invierno.entorno: The ground is bare cracked red earth with a few short dry tufts, and dark dust devils rise far off on the plain.
